RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus service is not running
RemediationStrings.Description: The antivirus service on your device is turned off, so it is not protected. Restart your device; if this message remains, contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is turned off
RemediationStrings.Description: Antivirus protection is disabled on your device. Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection and turn protection on, or contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Real-time protection is off
RemediationStrings.Description: Real-time antivirus protection is turned off. Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings and turn on Real-time protection.

RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is not the active antivirus ({ActualValue})
RemediationStrings.Description: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is running in a reduced mode on your device. This can happen when other antivirus software is installed. Please contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Tamper protection is off
RemediationStrings.Description: Tamper protection, which stops security settings being changed, is turned off. Please contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is out of date ({ActualValue})
RemediationStrings.Description: Your antivirus software needs updating. Open Settings > Windows Update and select Check for updates. If this message remains, contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Antivirus definitions are {ActualValue} days old
RemediationStrings.Description: Your antivirus definitions are out of date. Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Protection updates and select Check for updates.

RemediationStrings.Title: Windows Firewall is turned off
RemediationStrings.Description: Windows Firewall is off for at least one network type. Open Windows Security > Firewall & network protection and turn it on for Domain, Private and Public networks, or contact the helpdesk.
